text:
olivia brown: Hey team — remote new hire here. Received a ThinkPad with Windows 11 Pro. During OOBE it asked for a BitLocker recovery key and I didn't set one. The laptop is stuck on the recovery screen. I need WSL/Docker for my first-day tasks. Who can help with recovery and Intune/Autopilot enrollment?

matt - IT: Welcome @olivia brown! Don't enter any random keys. Pinging @intune-bot and @it-help-bot. Can you grab the device serial from the recovery screen (should be listed) or take a photo? Also confirm if the device came with a sticker or asset tag.

olivia brown: Photo attached: <recovery-screen.jpg>. Serial on the screen: PF1CNX123456. No separate asset tag visible.

intune-bot: Autopilot record lookup: serial PF1CNX123456 -> Autopilot profile = "redwood-default"; Intune device object exists but shows state: "requires-bitlocker-recovery". Opening case INTUNE-2026-4412 to request recovery key. Please provide purchaser email or PO number.

it-help-bot: Opening ticket INC-2026-22987. Olivia: run `Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_Bios | Select-Object SerialNumber` on a second Windows PC and paste if possible, or DM the photo to @matt - IT. Do not factory reset without IT.

olivia brown: DM'd the photo. Procurement email I received: procurement@redwood.com forwarded PO# PO-2026-1102. I can wait but need temporary access to complete WSL setup for pair programming in 90 minutes.

matt - IT: Two paths: 1) If we can retrieve the BitLocker key from Azure AD / Intune, we can restore and enroll; 2) issue a temporary loaner with dev tools preinstalled. I will check Intune for the recovery key. @jade - secops FYI.

jade - secops: If the BitLocker key is in Azure AD we can release it after verifying identity. We prefer not to reimage unless necessary. Olivia, can you confirm your company email and SSO via phone for the release?

procurement-bot: PO-2026-1102 -> vendor: Lenovo reseller X -> invoice attached. Shipping shows to Olivia at home address, date 2026-03-20.

intune-bot: Found BitLocker key in Azure AD for device object id {redacted}. Key snippet (last 8 digits): 7a9f-3c2b. To release full key, IT must verify identity and confirm device ownership.

matt - IT: Olivia please DM me to verify your ID (SSO challenge) and I'll release the key. If you need immediate access I can prepare a loaner image and ship or enable a remote desktop on a temporary VM. Which do you prefer?

olivia brown: I'll DM you now. Loaner would be slower — can you release the key? I can SSO on phone for verification.

matt - IT: Verified via DM SSO challenge. Releasing BitLocker key now. Key: 3F2B-...-9C7D (redacted in channel). Use that on the recovery screen to unlock and continue OOBE. After you boot, it should auto-join Azure AD and enroll in Intune; if not run `dsregcmd /status` and paste the output.

olivia brown: Entered key, device unlocked, OOBE resumed. Windows joined Azure AD and Intune says "enrolled". Ran `dsregcmd /status` and it shows Device State: AzureAdJoined = YES, DeviceId set.

intune-bot: Intune confirms device compliance profile applied. BitLocker protection enabled and recovery key escrow confirmed. Autopilot profile applied: "developer-laptop".

matt - IT: Great. Now about WSL/Docker: we avoid giving permanent local admin. I'll grant a 2-hour privileged elevation so you can install WSL, Docker Desktop (requires Hyper-V/WSL2 backend), and add your SSH key. Use only for these tasks. Temp creds DMed.

yubikey-bot: Reminder: if you plan to use a YubiKey for MFA or SSH, don't enroll the same private key that you use for personal accounts. Follow our onboarding doc for YubiKey provisioning: https://redwood.company/security/yubikey-onboard (SSO required).

olivia brown: Temp creds received. Installed WSL2, set up Ubuntu-22.04, installed Docker Desktop, and generated a new ed25519 SSH key with `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C \"olivia.brown@redwood.com\"`. Uploaded pubkey via the onboarding form.

jade - secops: Confirmed new device shows compliance true and BitLocker escrow present. Security note: revoke temp creds in 30 minutes if youre done. Also schedule a quick 15-min security orientation to cover device hygiene and YubiKey provisioning.

matt - IT: Temp session will auto-revoke at expiry. Marking INC-2026-22987 resolved, INTUNE-2026-4412 closed. Welcome aboard @olivia brown 604 — drop an intro in #general when you get a sec and well send a welcome kit.
